Projects & Technical Work

Explore selected systems, prototypes, platforms, and technical demonstrators developed by AICORE across robotics, embedded systems, IoT, AI, automation, and intelligent hardware.

Projects prove what AICORE has built, tested, and demonstrated. Products remain reusable commercial platforms, while case studies focus on verified client outcomes.

Trainable 7-DOF Robotic Arm with C# Teaching Interface: A working seven-degree-of-freedom robotic arm with a custom C# desktop interface for teaching positions, recording movement sequences, and replaying coordinated motion. Status: Completed Prototype. Capabilities: Seven-axis coordinated movement, Position teaching, Movement-sequence recording, Command playback, Desktop-to-controller communication, Custom operator-interface development.

Obstacle-Avoidance Mobile Robotic Rover: A working mobile robotic rover that detects nearby obstacles and adjusts its movement using onboard sensing, embedded decision logic, and motor-drive electronics. Status: Completed Prototype. Capabilities: Obstacle detection, Sensor-driven direction adjustment, Embedded decision logic, Motor-drive control, Mobile-platform integration, Prototype testing.

Voice-Controlled Robotic Platform: A working robotic platform controlled through supported spoken commands, combining voice recognition, command interpretation, embedded control, and motor actuation. Status: Completed Prototype. Capabilities: Supported spoken-command recognition, Voice-to-action command mapping, Embedded control, Motor actuation, Mobile-platform control, Human-robot interaction prototyping.
